name: Center of the Hills
summary: Center of the Hills is a well-rated community shopping center on Highway 71 in west Austin, managed by Kimco Realty. Serving the affluent Hill Country suburbs, it offers convenient daily shopping and services with strong community appeal.
demographics: Center of the Hills serves the affluent western Austin suburbs, particularly the 78735 zip code area which includes families with above-average household incomes and high educational attainment. The trade area attracts professionals and families seeking convenient shopping in the rapidly growing Hill Country corridor, with visitors typically ranging from young professionals to established families. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for quality everyday services, dining options, and convenience-oriented retail that serves the daily needs of the surrounding residential communities.
description: Center of the Hills is a prominent shopping destination strategically located along State Highway 71 in the desirable western Austin area. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, this property serves the thriving communities in the Texas Hill Country region. The center operates daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, providing convenient access to retail, dining, and services for residents of the 78735 area and beyond. With a strong 4.3-star rating from nearly 600 reviews, Center of the Hills has established itself as a reliable community gathering place. Its location along the busy Highway 71 corridor positions it perfectly to capture traffic from both local residents and visitors exploring the scenic western reaches of the Austin metropolitan area.
